description: G-5-195, on charge 11 May 1949 as I-095, retired 30 December 1970; gate guardian in front of the Edificio Cóndor for decades until removed by the FAA on the night of 18 July 2025 and taken to the Casino de Suboficiales; whether this is its permanent home is not yet known (Roll Out, July 2025).
aliases: Meteor F4; Meteor F Mk 4; I-095; I095
museum_name: Casino de Suboficiales FAA Gloster Meteor, Palermo
